name: Costco
summary:
Costco is the warehouse club at costco.com. Its tab icon sometimes arrives as an SVG even when the request path says favicon.ico. The format column reports what the bytes actually were.

Checked 12 November 2026 against costco.com. HTML came from https://www.costco.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.costco.com/nextGBrowseAssets/favicon.ico.

No favicon.ico URL returned an image on 12 November 2026. costco.com did not pass the image check for an .ico path. Formats that did save: webp, svg.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.costco.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 152×152 webp.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: webp-152x152-01.webp at 152×152 (webp, 5248 bytes) from https://www.costco.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
